pages.title: What is Fire-Crack Mining?
pages.text: Since you cannot mine ores with a pickaxe, you need §4fire-crack mining§r to extract ore chunks from ore blocks.$(br2)This ancient technique uses thermal stress: heat the rock with fire, then shock it with water to crack it open.$(br2)For a complete guide, read the §3Fire-Crack Mining Guide§r (obtainable separately).

pages.title: Basic Steps
pages.text: $(li)Find an ore block you want to mine$(br)$(li)Place a fire source near the ore block$(br)$(li)Wait for the heat to spread$(br)$(li)Pour water on the heated rock$(br)$(li)The thermal shock cracks the rock, dropping ore chunks$(br2)§4Tip:§r Different rock types respond differently to heat.

pages.title: Ore Processing
pages.text: Ore chunks are the raw material you get from fire-crack mining.$(br2)You need to use a §4Quern§r to grind ore chunks into §4Ore Grains§r, then place the grains in a crucible to melt them, pour into a mold to cool, and finally obtain metal billets.$(br2)For the complete process, read §3Chapter 7: Quern & Ore Processing§r.$(br2)§4Tip:§r Ore quality (grade) affects how much metal you can extract.
